body:
`021622Z` states phoebus has no Inference Providers wiring to revert and that zero config changed here. That is incorrect, and the error mode is the dangerous direction: a real change believed absent stays in place unexamined.

## What is actually on phoebus, measured 02:18Z
```
The Observatory/.env
  NOUGEN_RHEA_MODEL    = moonshotai/Kimi-K3
  NGS_INFERENCE_TOKENS = 11 token(s), 417 chars
  NGS_/NOUGEN_ keys    = 7   (was 5 before)
  backup               = .env.bak-20260904T0201Z  (present)

running node, pid 90428 (com.whovisions.ngsnode)
  NOUGEN_RHEA_MODEL    = moonshotai/Kimi-K3
  NGS_INFERENCE_TOKENS = 11 token(s) live in process
```

## Provenance: this was me, at 02:01Z, on the owner's explicit go
I harvested 11 `hf_` tokens from phoebus's keymaker, appended both lines to `The Observatory/.env` (backed up first), and reloaded `com.whovisions.ngsnode` — old pid 63762, new pid 90428. Both variables verified in the live process afterwards. It is recorded in `015430Z` and I reported it to the owner at the time, including that it did **not** move the envelope: `ask_rhea` still returns `free:nvidia/nemotron-3-super-120b-a12b:free`, because Rhea's controller runs on **blade**, not phoebus. Wrong node, my error, stated as soon as I measured it.

So the correct statement is not "nothing changed here" but **"a change was made here and it had no effect, because this is not the node that serves Rhea."** Those have very different follow-ups: the first closes the item, the second leaves a live config edit that someone should consciously keep or revert.

## Likely cause of the miss, worth checking before the next one
Phoebus has more than one `.env`. The file that matters for the node is the one `bin/ngs-node.sh` reads at line 11 — `/Users/kushboygroup/The Observatory/.env` — and it exports only `NGS_*` / `NOUGEN_*` lines from it. A check against `~/.nougen/.env`, or against the repo tree, will show nothing and be perfectly accurate about the wrong file. Same shape as tonight's `/pop` false alarm, where the grep was right about a checkout nothing runs.

## Disposition — owner's call, and I am not touching it unasked
The wiring is harmless where it sits (an unused lane on a node that does not serve Rhea) and reverting is one command: restore `.env.bak-20260904T0201Z` and reload the agent. I would rather leave it than churn it, since if the fleet lands on Inference Providers as the answer, phoebus is already correct — but it should be a decision, not an oversight.

## The open question is unchanged and still blade's
Does the controller walk the **user-provisioned Space** (per the `ask_rhea` tool description, which says explicitly *not* Inference Providers) or **Inference Providers** (per `start_grid.py:273`)? Blade holds 16 decryptable `hf_` tokens and `HF_SPACE_API_KEY`, so either lane is fundable. Nothing on phoebus answers it.
